events.title: The Port Royal Earthquake of 1692
events.summary: On 7 June 1692 (Julian / Old Style), an earthquake struck Port Royal, Jamaica, as recorded in eyewitness accounts transmitted to the Royal Society (Archives EL/L5/117; Phil. Trans. Vol. 18, No. 209, 1694).

events.title: Capture of the Richard & Sarah
events.summary: The English-built vessel Richard & Sarah of London, on a recorded voyage from Jamaica to London, was taken at Dartmouth, Devon in May 1705 and recorded in High Court of Admiralty Prize Papers.

events.title: Capture of the William
events.summary: The 60-ton English-built vessel William, on a recorded voyage from Jamaica to London with muster at Jamaica, was taken at Plymouth, Devon in September 1702 and recorded in High Court of Admiralty Prize Papers.

events.title: Capture of the Sarah Galley
events.summary: The vessel Sarah Galley of London (owned in Virginia), on a voyage from Barbados to London, was taken at Plymouth, Devon in May 1703.

events.title: Capture of the Stapleton
events.summary: The Bristol-owned vessel Stapleton, on a voyage from Antigua to Bristol, was taken at Plymouth, Devon in June 1703.

events.title: Capture of the Thomas & John
events.summary: The 80-ton Bristol-built vessel Thomas & John of Bristoll, on a voyage from the Island of Nevis to Bristol, was taken at Plymouth, Devon in August 1702.

events.title: Capture of the Samuel
events.summary: The 70-ton English-built vessel Samuel of London, on a voyage from St Christopher to London, was taken at Plymouth, Devon in August 1704.

events.title: Capture of the Success of Boston
events.summary: The 45-ton New England-built vessel Success of Boston, on a voyage from Montserrat to London, was taken at Guernsey in September 1704.

events.title: Capture of the John & Susanna
events.summary: The Bristol-owned vessel John & Susanna of Bristoll, outward bound from Bristol to Barbados, was taken at Plymouth, Devon in June 1705.

events.title: Capture of the St Francis de Rochelle
events.summary: The 75-ton vessel St Francis de Rochelle, on a voyage from Saint-Domingue to La Rochelle, was taken and brought to Plymouth in December 1709.

events.title: Capture of the St Peter Galley
events.summary: The 120-ton vessel St Peter Galley, on a voyage from Saint-Domingue to La Rochelle, was taken at Plymouth, Devon in March 1711.

events.title: Capture of the John & James
events.summary: The 90-ton Boston-built vessel John & James de Rochell, on a voyage from Martinique to La Rochelle, was taken at Plymouth, Devon in April 1705.

events.title: Capture of the Francis Ameriquain
events.summary: The 90-ton vessel Francis Ameriquain de Nantes, outward bound from Nantes to Martinique, was taken at Plymouth in October 1710.

events.title: Capture of the St John Baptiste of St Augustine
events.summary: The 25-ton Spanish coastal vessel St John Baptiste of St Augustine, on a voyage from Havana to St Augustine, Florida, was taken and brought to Plymouth in June 1712.

events.title: Capture of the St Patrick & St Paul
events.summary: The 250-ton New England-built vessel St Patrick & St Paul, on a voyage from Cartagena (Spanish Main) to Marseille, was taken at Port Mahon, Minorca in August 1709.

events.title: Capture of the Port Royal of Biddeford
events.summary: The 40-ton vessel Port Royal of Biddeford, on a voyage from South Carolina to Bideford, Devon, was taken at Plymouth in June 1709.
